notes: v21 enemy (Hollow region): Swarmling, a skittery swarm biter. A small pear-shaped moss puff on four stubby rust legs, two curled rust horns at the cheeks, a spiky leaf crest, violet glow-slit eyes. Crowd unit drawn through Live3D's merged swarm batches: HARD budget of 6 bones (root, body, head, legs_F, legs_B, crest) and ~1.5k tris (1499 after prep). Front feet at x -0.45/+0.35, hind feet at x -0.34/+0.13 (the mesh is asymmetric); each leg PAIR is one bone (one swing for both feet). Horns are forced rigid to head (rigid_regions, no bone). Personality: Skittery - quick hop-waddle, scrappy bite, jittery idle.
_placed_by: v21: placed by the writer from z/x mesh sections (zsec.py), a midline z-profile probe and the calibrated views; checked with tools/lmcheck.py (blob mode). body column x=0,y=0 from the floor to z 1.15 (ball 0..~1.24; the spikes reach 1.42); head follower from inside the ball (y -0.2, z 0.55) to the face front (y -0.6, z 0.5, face section z 0.30..0.90); leg-pair bones on the line between each pair of feet (tails unsnapped: they sit between the feet, outside the mesh by design). lmcheck: 4 points report OUTSIDE, all by design and unsnapped: the leg-pair tails (between each pair of feet, on the floor), the crest tail (among the spikes above the ball) and body_top (only sets the body bone's length; the sparse low-poly crown has open leaf cards, so the ray-parity test is unreliable there). Every other point is inside.
